name: exfu
description: The ExFu marketplace: Alastair Brayne's Claude Code plugins in one place — the Agent Library (solo, team, team-admin), the ExFu planning methodology, and the Agent Plan Visualiser.

plugins.name: exfu-agent-plan-visualiser
plugins.description: Event-sourced planning methodology with git-history extraction and projection. Walks a project's git history, extracts structured events against a defined ontology, and provides projections (audits, diagrams, status reports) over the resulting event log.
